en: The Path of Discrimination 2.
The Chapter on the Coupling 2.3.
Discourse on the Factors of Enlightenment (Bojjhaṅgakathā)
The setting was at Sāvatthī.
"Monks, there are these seven factors of enlightenment.
Which seven?"

The mindfulness enlightenment factor, the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor, the energy enlightenment factor, the rapture enlightenment factor, the tranquility enlightenment factor, the concentration enlightenment factor, and the equanimity enlightenment factor—
these, monks, are the seven enlightenment factors.
In what sense are they called "enlightenment factors"?
They conduce to enlightenment, thus they are factors of enlightenment (bojjhaṅga). They awaken, thus they are factors of enlightenment. They awaken thoroughly, thus they are factors of enlightenment.
They awaken—thus they are enlightenment factors (bojjhaṅga). They fully awaken—thus they are enlightenment factors.

In the sense of awakening, they are enlightenment factors; in the sense of subsequent awakening, they are enlightenment factors; in the sense of full awakening, they are enlightenment factors; in the sense of complete awakening, they are enlightenment factors.
They awaken, thus they are factors of awakening (bojjhaṅga).
They cause one to awaken, thus they are factors of awakening. They cause one to awaken thoroughly, thus they are factors of awakening.
They awaken, thus they are factors of enlightenment (*bojjhaṅga*). They are factors of enlightenment in the sense of awakening; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of subsequent awakening;

they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of full awakening; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of complete awakening. They are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being on the side of awakening; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being on the side of subsequent awakening; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being on the side of full awakening; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being on the side of complete awakening.

(The Fifth Tetrad) The enlightenment factors are so called in the sense of attaining enlightenment; they are enlightenment factors in the sense of obtaining wisdom; they are enlightenment factors in the sense of placing one in wisdom;

they are enlightenment factors in the sense of bringing one to wisdom; they are enlightenment factors in the sense of leading to wisdom; they are enlightenment factors in the sense of conducting one to the perfection of wisdom.

The Decade on the Root-Rootedness:
The enlightenment factors in the sense of being roots; the enlightenment factors in the sense of the practice of roots; the enlightenment factors in the sense of the comprehension of roots.

The enlightenment factors are so called in the sense of being the root’s retinue; they are the enlightenment factors in the sense of fulfilling the root; they are the enlightenment factors in the sense of maturing the root;
they are the enlightenment factors in the sense of the analytical knowledge of the root; they are the enlightenment factors in the sense of bringing about the analytical knowledge of the root;

they are the enlightenment factors in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of the root; and they are the enlightenment factors even for those who have attained mastery over the analytical knowledge of the root.

The factors of enlightenment in the sense of cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the course of the cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the discernment of the cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the retinue of the cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the fulfillment of the cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the maturation of the cause;
the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the analytical knowledge of the cause; the factors of enlightenment in the sense of leading to the analytical knowledge of the cause.

The factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of cause; they are the factors of enlightenment for those who have attained mastery over the analytical knowledge of cause.

They are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of condition; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the practice of conditions; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the discernment of conditions; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the accompaniment of conditions; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the fulfillment of conditions; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the maturation of conditions.

The factors of enlightenment (bojjhaṅga) are so called in the sense of analytical knowledge of conditions; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of leading to analytical knowledge of conditions;

they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of mastery over analytical knowledge of conditions; and they are factors of enlightenment even for those who have attained mastery over analytical knowledge of conditions.
They are factors of enlightenment in the sense of purity; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the conduct of purity; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of embracing purity.

The factors of enlightenment: they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being the retinue of purification; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the fulfillment of purification; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the maturation of purification; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the analytical knowledge of purification; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of bringing about the analytical knowledge of purification;

they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of purification; [they are factors of enlightenment] in the sense of the analytical knowledge of purification...

The factors of enlightenment are so called because they have attained mastery; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of being blameless, in the sense of blameless conduct, in the sense of blameless possession, in the sense of blameless retinue, and in the sense of blameless fulfillment.
The factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of the ripening of what is blameless; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of the analytical knowledge of what is blameless;

the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of leading to the analytical knowledge of what is blameless; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of what is blameless; and the factors of enlightenment are so called even for those who have attained mastery over the analytical knowledge of what is blameless.

The factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of renunciation; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of conduct of renunciation; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of embracing renunciation; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of being the retinue of renunciation;
the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of fulfilling renunciation; the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of the maturation of renunciation;
the factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of the analytical knowledge of renunciation; [and] in the sense of leading to the analytical knowledge of renunciation.

The factors of enlightenment: they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of renunciation; they are factors of enlightenment for those who have attained mastery over the analytical knowledge of renunciation.

They are factors of enlightenment in the sense of liberation; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the conduct of liberation; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the embracing of liberation.

The factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of being the retinue of liberation; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of fulfilling liberation; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the maturation of liberation;

they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of the analytical knowledge of liberation; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of bringing about the analytical knowledge of liberation;

they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of mastery over the analytical knowledge of liberation; and they are the factors of enlightenment even for those who have attained mastery over the analytical knowledge of liberation.

The factors of enlightenment are so called in the sense of being taintless; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of taintless conduct; they are the factors of enlightenment in the sense of taintless embracing;

They are factors of enlightenment in the sense of relinquishment; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the practice of relinquishment; they are factors of enlightenment in the sense of the embracing of relinquishment.

They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken to the yoke-pair in the sense of non-excess.
They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken to purification of virtue in the sense of restraint.
They are "factors of enlightenment" (bojjhaṅga) because they awaken to purification of mind in the sense of non-distraction.
They are "factors of enlightenment" because they awaken to purification of view in the sense of seeing.
They are "factors of enlightenment" because they awaken to liberation in the sense of being released.
They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken to true knowledge in the sense of penetration;
they are called enlightenment factors because they awaken to liberation in the sense of relinquishment;
they are called enlightenment factors because they awaken to the knowledge of destruction in the sense of complete eradication.
They are awakening factors because they awaken to non-arising in the sense of subsiding.
They are awakening factors because they awaken to zeal in the sense of being its root.
They are awakening factors because they awaken to attention in the sense of its origination.
They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken by way of the meaning of convergence upon contact.
They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken by way of the meaning of meeting at feeling.
They are called enlightenment factors because they awaken by way of the meaning of being preeminent in concentration.
They awaken to mindfulness in the sense of predominance, thus they are factors of awakening.
They awaken to wisdom in the sense of being supreme, thus they are factors of awakening.
They awaken to liberation in the sense of the core, thus they are factors of awakening.
They awaken to Nibbāna, which is unfathomable, in the sense of its finality; thus they are called "factors of awakening.
The setting was at Sāvatthī.
There, the Venerable Sāriputta addressed the bhikkhus:
“Friends, monks.
“Friend,” those monks replied to the Venerable Sāriputta.
The Venerable Sāriputta said this:
“Friends, there are these seven factors of enlightenment.
Which seven?
The mindfulness factor of enlightenment, the investigation-of-phenomena factor of enlightenment … [and so on] …”
The enlightenment factor of equanimity—
these, friends, are the seven factors of enlightenment.

And of these seven factors of enlightenment, friends, whichever factor of enlightenment I wish to dwell in during the morning session, in that very factor of enlightenment I dwell during the morning session.
By whichever factor of enlightenment I desire to dwell during the middle watch of the night...
[and] during the evening watch, by that very factor of enlightenment I dwell during the evening watch.
If there is the thought to me, "Friend, the mindfulness-enlightenment-factor is present," it occurs to me, "It is immeasurable," and it occurs to me, "It is well undertaken."
And when it stands, I know: ‘It stands.
Even if it passes away from me, I know: ‘Through this specific condition it passes away from me.
The factor of enlightenment of investigation of phenomena... [and so on].
"Friends, when there is the enlightenment factor of equanimity in me, I know: 'It is immeasurable,' I know: 'It is well undertaken,' and I know: 'It is present.
And if it should cease in me, I know: 'Through this specific condition it has ceased in me.'"
"Friend, it is just as if a king or a king’s high minister had a chest full of various colored cloths.
Whatever pair of cloths he might wish to wear in the morning, that very pair of cloths he would wear in the morning;
whatever pair of cloths he might wish to wear at midday... [and so on].
If one wished to wear that very same pair of robes in the evening, one would wear that very same pair of robes in the evening.
In the same way, friend, whichever of these seven factors of enlightenment I wish to dwell in during the morning, in that factor of enlightenment I dwell during the morning;
whichever factor of enlightenment I wish to dwell in during the midday period... [and so on].
To dwell during the evening time, I dwell during the evening time with this or that factor of enlightenment.
Friend, if there is the mindfulness factor of enlightenment in me, I know: "It is immeasurable," I know: "It is well undertaken.
And while it persists, I understand: "It persists."
Even if I pass away, I understand: ‘It is through this specific condition that I am passing away.
... [as before] ... Friends, if there is the enlightenment factor of equanimity in me, I know: ‘It is immeasurable,’ I know: ‘It is well undertaken.
And while it persists, I know: ‘It persists.’
"Even if I pass away, I understand: 'It is through this specific condition that I pass away.
2.3.2. Exposition of the Discourse:
"How is it that 'the factor of enlightenment called mindfulness' occurs to me? Thus it is a factor of enlightenment.
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent there is the enlightenment factor of mindfulness.
"Thus it is for me"—this is an enlightenment factor.
Just as, when an oil lamp is burning, to the extent that there is a flame, to that extent there is color; and to the extent that there is color, to that extent there is a flame.
In the same way, to the extent that cessation is established, to that extent there is the enlightenment factor of mindfulness.
"Thus it is with me"—this is an enlightenment factor.
How is it immeasurable that "thus it is with me" is an enlightenment factor?

The defilements are limited in measure, as are all obsessions and those formations that lead to renewed existence; but cessation is immeasurable in its sense of immovability and its sense of being unconditioned.
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent it is immeasurable.
"If this is so for me"—this is a factor of enlightenment.
"How is it that 'it is well undertaken,' such that it occurs to me, [that this is] a factor of enlightenment?

Uneven are the defilements, and all the obsessions, as are those formations that lead to renewed existence; cessation is of the same nature [as the path], in the sense of being peaceful and in the sense of being sublime.
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent "it is well undertaken," such that it occurs to me, [that this is] a factor of enlightenment.
How do I understand: "While it stands, it stands"? And if it passes away, how do I understand: "It passes away through this specific condition"?
In how many ways does the mindfulness enlightenment factor stand?
In how many ways does the mindfulness enlightenment factor pass away?
The enlightenment factor of mindfulness stands firm through eight modes; it falls away through eight modes.
By which eight modes does the enlightenment factor of mindfulness stand firm?
The factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands because of having adverted to non-arising; the factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands because of not having adverted to arising;
the factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands because of having adverted to non-occurrence; the factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands because of not having adverted to occurrence;
the factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands because of having adverted to the signless; [the factor of enlightenment of mindfulness stands] because of [not having adverted to] the sign.
The mindfulness enlightenment factor abides because of not attending to [the world]; the mindfulness enlightenment factor abides because of attending to cessation;
the mindfulness enlightenment factor abides because of not attending to formations—in these eight ways the mindfulness enlightenment factor abides.
In what eight ways does the enlightenment factor of mindfulness decline?
The enlightenment factor of mindfulness declines because of attending to arising; it declines because of not attending to non-arising;
it declines because of attending to occurrence; it declines because of not attending to non-occurrence.
The enlightenment factor of mindfulness falters because of attending to a sign; it falters because of not attending to the signless;
it falters because of attending to mental formations; it falters because of not attending to cessation—it is through these eight modes that the enlightenment factor of mindfulness falters.
Thus, when it stands, I understand: "It stands. And even if it passes away, I understand: "It passes away for me due to this specific condition" ... [as before] ...
How is it that equanimity-enlightenment-factor is an enlightenment-factor insofar as it occurs to me: "Equanimity-enlightenment-factor"?
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent it is an enlightenment-factor insofar as it occurs to me: "Equanimity-enlightenment-factor."
Just as, when an oil lamp burns, as far as there is flame, so far there is color;

and as far as there is color, so far there is flame—even so, as long as cessation is established, for that long there is the enlightenment factor of equanimity. If it is thus, it is called an "enlightenment factor.
How is it that, if it is thus, it is called an "immeasurable enlightenment factor"?
The defilements are limited in measure, as are all obsessions and those formations that lead to renewed existence; cessation is immeasurable by way of its immovability and its unconditioned nature.
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent it is immeasurable—thus it is a factor of enlightenment (*bojjhaṅga*).
How is it a factor of enlightenment in the sense of being "well undertaken"?
The defilements are uneven, as are all obsessions, and those formations that lead to renewed existence; their cessation is of the same nature. In the sense of peace, it is sublime.
To the extent that cessation is established, to that extent one thinks, "It is well undertaken"—this is a factor of enlightenment (*bojjhaṅga*).
How do I know: "While it stands, it stands"? And even if one passes away, how do I know: "By this specific condition I pass away"?
In how many ways does the enlightenment factor of equanimity (upekkhā-sambojjhaṅga) stand firm?
In how many ways does the enlightenment factor of equanimity fall away?
The enlightenment factor of equanimity stands firm in eight ways.
The enlightenment factor of equanimity falls away in eight ways.
By which eight ways does the enlightenment factor of equanimity persist?
The enlightenment factor of equanimity persists because of having adverted to non-arising; the enlightenment factor of equanimity [persists] because of not having adverted to arising.
It stands; because of having adverted to non-occurrence, the enlightenment factor of equanimity stands; because of not having adverted to occurrence, the enlightenment factor of equanimity stands;
because of having adverted to the signless, the enlightenment factor of equanimity stands;
because of not having adverted to the sign, the enlightenment factor of equanimity stands; because of having adverted to cessation, the enlightenment factor of equanimity stands.
It stands; because of not having directed the mind toward formations, the equanimity enlightenment factor stands—in these eight ways the equanimity enlightenment factor stands.
By which eight ways does the equanimity enlightenment factor fall away?
The enlightenment factor of equanimity falters because of attending to arising; it falters because of not attending to non-arising;
it falters because of attending to occurrence; it falters because of not attending to non-occurrence;
it falters because of attending to the sign; it falters because of [not attending to] the signless.
The enlightenment factor of equanimity fails because of not attending to the mind; the enlightenment factor of equanimity fails because of attending to mental formations;
the enlightenment factor of equanimity fails because of not attending to cessation—it is through these eight modes that the enlightenment factor of equanimity fails.
Thus I understand: "While it stands, it stands"; and if it passes away, I understand: "It passes away for me due to this specific condition.
The Discourse on the Factors of Enlightenment is concluded.
